IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Friday, September 18, 2026**

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** is running hot on data center work. Cupertino and Gurtz both posting 30-hand calls at Port Washington Data Center with **JW wage plus $10/hr base wage included** — that's real money for a repost job that's clearly been rolling. Wil-Surge and Pieper Electric holding secondary calls on the same complex. Book depth is tight at 200 hands across 44 calls; if you can start Monday, these dry fast.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** is the board to watch for volume. Sixty-three calls, 451 hands available, and Miller Electrical, Inglett & Stubbs, and Whitehead all sitting on similar work: **$42/hr** on data hall buildout and cable tray hanging in the Fayetteville QTS cluster. **4-10s and 2-8s** Mon-Sat starts. Book 1 is moving—this is production work, not a flash fill.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** is a specialist's play. B & D Industries and Mass Electric both chasing the Miner project in Santa Teresa, NM at **$55/hr** with double-time OT; Alterman's Meta job hits **$71.5/hr** but requires state licensing. Only 34 hands on the bench, so moves happen fast. Per diem runs real here.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** has 18 Inside JW calls at Parsons Electric for Polaris Forge Data Center (Harwood) at **$44.8/hr**, **$100/day per diem non-taxed**, **6-10s**. Secondary calls on fire alarm and compressor station work. Still 59 hands available; North Dakota residency and licensing required, but the work is steady.

**LU-26 Washington, DC** is posting 69 calls but rates aren't listed—however JE Richards has 37 hands needed at QTS-DC4 in Manassas (LOTO and NFPA 70E cert work), Hi Tech's running 23 at the Convention Center, and Mass is staffing WMATA traction power upgrades across the region. Volume is there; pay is opaque but metro DC work typically holds.

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** rounds out the stack: Eli Lilly new construction at **$54.75/hr** top call, Industrial Electric running **13 days on/1 off rotations** with **7-10s**, and Google Data Center Mooresville with double-time OT on outdoor rework. 111 hands, 36 calls—solid middle-market board.

**The market is chasing data centers and industrial builds: Midwest and Southwest hitting hardest, per diem is real money now, and night shift and rotating schedules are the premium work.**

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Friday, September 18, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is running hot with 46 calls and roughly 140 hands on the board. NEW RIVER ELECT. CORP. is the anchor—40 JL spots in Columbus on distribution work with $125 per diem nights stayed plus a $125 bonus on 10-hour days, 6-10s, CDL required. Same contractor has 9 more JL slots in Southern Ohio distro, 4-10s with optional Friday/Saturday, same per diem. CAPITAL ELECTRIC LINE BUILDERS needs 6 JL for cable splicing in Johnstown at $100/day per diem, OSHA 10 and Class A CDL mandatory.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** sits at 31 calls with **$56.80/hr** on SERVICE ELECTRIC's dual Social Circle JL calls (27 slots combined, barehand cert required, $150/day per diem, plus $10/hr over scale). Same contractor's statewide substation tech work runs **$44.46/hr**. HEART UTILITIES pushing 7 more JL spots Northeast Georgia at **$46.80/hr**, 4-10s, $150/day per diem.

**LU-66 Houston, TX** has 19 calls across three major contractors. NHPL dominates with 19 JL distribution spots (all OT double time, $150/day per diem, Class A CDL), 9 more on transmission in Floresville at $175/day per diem, and 8 transmission tech positions. Class A CDL non-negotiable across the board.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** packed 24 calls into 59 hands. PARSONS ELECTRIC is the draw—18 Inside JL at the Polaris Forge Data Center in Harwood, **$44.80/hr** base, $100/day non-taxed per diem, 6-10s with incentive pay, GPS radius 100+ miles. MICHELS POWER's compressor station call in St. Vincent, Minnesota offers $200/day per diem, 6-10s, bidding 8pm 9/1.

**LU-1393 Indianapolis, IN** landed 37 calls on 54 hands. ARC AMERICAN's 5 JL Wanatah rebuild spots hit **$64.66/hr**, no per diem but 12.5k rebuilds keep the work rolling, CDL A required. MJ ELECTRIC's Winamac transmission circuit install goes **$67.18/hr**, $105/day per diem, 345kv experience needed.

**LU-70 Forestville, MD** punches above its 14-call weight with MILLER BROS hitting **$126/hr** on substation work DC area, $125/day per diem—highest single call on the board today.

Data-center work is absorbing the biggest labor pools; transmission and substation rebuilds still move the specialized pay.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Friday, September 18, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is carrying 18 calls with 61 hands needed. BCS Mechanical is the anchor here—15 JW Pipefitters and 13 JW Plumbers both on the Sego Project in West Valley running 4-10s starting Aug 3. DSI's got 6 JW Pipefitters at QTS in Eagle Mountain on a tighter 5-8 schedule with **$10.00** on that call, plus 5 apprentices available. Book is loose and moving.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** shows 23 calls chasing 47 hands, all intel work at Ronler Acres in Hillsboro. Apollo Mechanical needs 8 CAD/BIM Detailers (Ticket #71649), Charter's running 5 Fitters and 3 Orbital Welders on tool install, plus 4 High Purity Fitters. Specialty certifications rule the board here—no commodity work.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** is tighter: 14 calls, 40 hands. Kiewit's the headline—8 positions at **$65.00** with **$65 per diem**, CWI required, night shift with 15% differential on 5/10s+8. US Eng. Metalworks is hiring 11 fitters for night shop work; Murphy's Coors 4-can filler wants SS Sch5/Sch10 experience. This board rewards certifications and swing shifts.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** is compact but hungry: 5 calls, 18 hands. Nooter at Cenovus offers **$125/day per diem** with incentive pay for 5 pipefitters on 7-10s (must get current in DISA). Gem's fab shop needs 5 combo welders. Graham and Upland round out maintenance and data center work. Industrial process piping and fab shops paying the bills here.

**LU-525 Las Vegas, NV** has 1 call pulling 12 hands to Four Seasons towers in Henderson—JWs only, OSHA 10/30required, started 7/30. Light board, single deep call.

**LU-213 St John, NB** and **LU-325 Fredericton, NB** together show Irving Oil Refinery and Irving Pulp & Paper driving Maritime work—welders and pipefitters on test-required positions, apprentice instrument tech slots. Shutdown incentive work.

The money's in specialty certs (high purity, SS experience, CWI, welding test quals) and swing shifts; data centers and refineries are pulling hard.
